relationship_vocabulary.REQUIRED_FOR: A is required for B within the explicitly bounded procedure/model being represented. Strong relation; must be reviewed conservatively.
relationship_vocabulary.FACILITATES: A supports or makes B easier/more available, but B is not asserted to be impossible without A.
relationship_vocabulary.PART_OF: A is a constituent subskill/process element of the broader target B.
relationship_vocabulary.BUILDS_ON: B extends, operationalizes, or conceptually builds on A without asserting strict necessity.
relationship_vocabulary.OVERLAPS_WITH: A and B represent partially shared mathematical structure across domains; neither is asserted to contain the other.
